label: Critical
impact_and_urgency: Critical business capability unavailable or materially unsafe; immediate impact; no acceptable fallback
staffing_prerequisites: Funded round-the-clock primary and backup responders; incident authority; tested paging and provider escalation
scope_notes: Activate incident process immediately; these goals do not delay authorized containment

label: High
impact_and_urgency: Major impairment or urgent business deadline; limited fallback
staffing_prerequisites: Staffed weekday queue; named alternate; specialist and provider handoff within the usable service window
scope_notes: Restoration objective applies to service disruption; planned fulfillment needs a scoped due date

label: Normal
impact_and_urgency: Bounded impact; usable workaround; non-immediate deadline
staffing_prerequisites: Staffed weekday queue; daily review; named service owner and planned specialist capacity
scope_notes: Restoration objective applies to service disruption; calendar breaks are not discretionary pauses

label: Low
impact_and_urgency: Minor impact or planned work with flexible timing
staffing_prerequisites: Staffed weekday queue; scheduled backlog capacity; owner for progress and expectation setting
scope_notes: Complex projects and purchasing are not promised within this restoration objective
